situation.text: Discussion on the challenges faced by sales agents in recruiting agencies for larger developers in Dubai.

citations.quote: But let me ask you this. Why would a developer pay you salary?

observation.text: The speaker uses a rhetorical question, "Why would a developer pay you salary?" to introduce the topic of productivity and KPIs.

citations.quote: Do you know that each and every agency in Dubai already have someone who is in touch with them from Shoba, Damak, Hill, Imar, just name it. Do you? Aha. So you do.

observation.text: The speaker uses a rhetorical question, "do you know that each and every agency in Dubai already have someone..." to challenge the audience's awareness of the competitive landscape.

citations.quote: Yes, you can. And you can get anywhere from eight thousand dirhams, which is two thousand euro or, you know, calculated into pounds, up to twelve, which is three thousand euro.

summary.text: Developers may offer sales agents a salary ranging from 8,000 to 12,000 dirhams, equating to 2,000 to 3,000 euros.

citations.quote: they will ask for your productivity, for your KPIs, and you're going to have them in a very, very determined and strict way. There are some developers who will give you an approximate target of six million to sell on a six million volume within the first month because you are just fresh and new, and then from second to third, they're going to move it to twelve.

summary.text: Developers typically require high productivity and KPIs, with initial sales volume targets starting at six million and potentially increasing to twelve million.

citations.quote: But what developer will not give you most of the time is leads. The developers, majority of them, they do not sell directly to the clients and they don't want to have that hassle of chasing this one client, convincing him.

summary.text: Developers typically do not provide leads to sales agents and focus on selling only their own projects.

citations.quote: you can only sell the project of this developer. You cannot just go on the market and do secondary. You cannot just go on the market and sell off-plan project of other developers.

summary.text: In a developer Salesforce, agents can only sell the developer’s project and not secondary or off-plan projects of other developers.

citations.quote: He will get, for example, five percent, and you, as an agent from the developer side, will get maybe zero point five slash zero point eight, maybe one.

summary.text: An agent working directly for a developer may earn a lower commission, typically 0.5% to 0.8%, compared to 5% for an agent in an agency.

citations.quote: So why wouldn't we offer the developers to be the outsourced sales centers? We're going to take the bigger percentage from them as a master brokerage.

summary.text: Master brokerages act as outsourced sales centers for developers and handle sales through their agency networks.

citations.quote: The difference between the developer and master brokerage besides you being able to do a lot of things is that the master brokerage will not pay you a basic salary.

summary.text: While a developer may offer a basic salary with strict KPI requirements, a master brokerage may not offer a base salary but provides more flexibility.
